lessons.trigger_condition: V391 can diagnose operational faults, stress-test decisions, block verified regression and maintain a non-executable feature lifecycle, but the current runtime still lacks an explicit one-at-a-time owned self-extension record with a baseline KPI, automatic rollback of that exact added capability after material operational regression or an upstream hard hold, and verified canary evidence gates for protected-PR promotion.
lessons.prevention_rule: V397 must keep V391/V390 and every prior hard gate mandatory, add at most one V397-owned canonical V373 declarative capability for the next cycle, persist its baseline operational KPI, remove only that exact owned capability after a material KPI drop or upstream hold, use operational market-flow evidence only, and allow source-level feature promotion to protected-PR candidate only after explicit verified canary successes, positive verified KPI delta and actual-output validation.
validation_required: functional watched-path candidate is exactly fff9ed46696f7b9148c61c60f97f62a820527fa7
watched paths are main, tablet_autonomous_evolution_v397.py and tablet_runtime_manifest.py
main evolve route uses tablet_autonomous_evolution_v397.py with tablet_gpt domain
tablet runtime manifest includes v397 while preserving v391, v390 and prior controllers
V397 selects only operational modes from freshness, coverage, source health, V391 diagnosis, drift, uncertainty, neural consensus and resource headroom
at most one V397-owned canonical V373 declarative capability is active and is next-cycle only
V391 and V390 are invoked with apply_capabilities false so they cannot persist a competing capability during the V397 owned lifecycle
V397 records a baseline operational KPI for its owned capability
material operational KPI regression or a V391 upstream hard hold requests rollback of only the exact V397-owned capability
missing or expired owned capabilities are reconciled from bounded device-local state without importing peer state
source features require at least two verified canary successes, positive verified KPI delta and verified output before protected-PR candidacy
source-level feature candidates remain non-executable and still require protected PR/CI, targeted tests, regression, full runtime, repository integrity and Tablet GPT alignment
market direction, facts, prices and grades are never invented
source code is never auto-generated or auto-rewritten and Git/main is never written by runtime autonomy
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V397 may autonomously choose an operational mode, own one allowlisted declarative runtime extension, measure it, roll back only that owned extension after verified operational regression, and promote verified source-feature evidence to a protected-PR candidate. It does not generate or rewrite source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, bypass V391/V390/V388 or earlier verification, promote unverified facts/prices/grades, infer market direction, import peer weights/raw state, or claim physical-device success without evidence.
